title: ze_Resident_Evil_3
description:
This map was made for zombie escape mode 

 To properly play this map on your custom server, you will need the necessary plugins available at 

 The map is still in development, some things may change! 

 Another remake version of our old CS:GO map 

 Map includes: 

Three different difficulty levels: Normal/Hard/Akumu

2 different endings

1 Boss fight (for now)

Random spawn NPC's (3 different type)

6 human items ( Weapon charges are restored when the necessary ammunition is picked up )

1 zm item "Licker" (LMB - standart attack, RMB - Jump, E - tongue grab attack)

Many different random events and fully random weather

Several types of puzzles
